The Infernal Rapist
The Infernal Rapist (Spanish:El violador infernal) is a 1988 Mexican horror and thriller film directed by Damián Acosta Esparza. The film starring Noé Murayama, Princesa Lea, Ana Luisa Peluffo, Marisol Cervantes, Manuel 'Flaco' Ibáñez and Fidel Abregoin the lead roles.
